metalaxyl.name: Metalaxyl
metalaxyl.explanation: A fungicide component. Consult the product label for the specific pathogens and uses covered.

broflanilide.name: Broflanilide
broflanilide.explanation: An insecticide component; Teraxxa's source entry lists wireworms.

ipconazole.name: Ipconazole
ipconazole.explanation: A fungicide component. A shared group indicates a related mode of action, not equivalent performance.

picoxystrobin.name: Picoxystrobin
picoxystrobin.explanation: A fungicide component that acts on fungal respiration. Product-specific uses come from the label.

fludioxonil.name: Fludioxonil
fludioxonil.explanation: A fungicide component. Its mode-of-action group describes biological activity, not an efficacy rating.

thiamethoxam.name: Thiamethoxam
thiamethoxam.explanation: An insecticide component. Check the label for the crop, target pest, and use restrictions.

sedaxane.name: Sedaxane
sedaxane.explanation: A fungicide component. Different products with this group may have different uses and performance.

pydiflumetofen.name: Pydiflumetofen
pydiflumetofen.explanation: A fungicide component; the Saltro source entry also lists nematode targets. Refer to the label for the specific claims.

fluopyram.name: Fluopyram
fluopyram.explanation: A fungicide component; the Ilevo source entry also lists nematode targets. Refer to the label for the specific claims.

mefenoxam.name: Mefenoxam
mefenoxam.explanation: The CruiserMaxx Vibrance specimen label lists this fungicide component. A mode-of-action group is not an efficacy rating.

oxathiapiprolin.name: Oxathiapiprolin
oxathiapiprolin.explanation: The LumiTreo specimen label lists this fungicide component. Refer to the label for the specific crop and pathogen claims.

metalaxyl-m.name: Metalaxyl-M
metalaxyl-m.explanation: EPA PC code 113502 is listed under Metalaxyl-M and mefenoxam. This fungicide component is FRAC group 4. Follow the product label for specific uses.
